collection.label: Papyrus Prisse (Kagemni and Ptahhotep)
collection.author_name: Papyrus Prisse, Thebes (12th Dynasty, c. 1850 BCE)
collection.critical_edition: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae, ed. Peter Dils (2018 data, AED-TEI)
collection.search_terms: ptahhotep ptah-hotep kagemni ke'gemni prisse papyrus wisdom maxims instruction sebayt vizier isesi
collection.description: The Papyrus Prisse (BnF, c. 1850 BCE), the oldest complete copy of the Instruction of Ptahhotep, with the end of the Instruction for Kagemni: every column photographed, TLA transliteration and hieroglyphs, Gunn's 1906 English.

texts.title: The Instruction for Kagemni (Papyrus Prisse, pages 1-2)
texts.date_approx: Middle Kingdom composition; manuscript c. 1850 BCE (12th Dynasty)
texts.source: Papyrus Prisse, BnF Egyptien 183 (photographs by Zunkir, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0) + TLA transliteration (ed. P. Dils, CC BY-SA 4.0) + English of Battiscombe Gunn (1906, public domain)
texts.description: The closing part of the Instruction for Kagemni, an Old Kingdom style wisdom text, on the first two columns of the Papyrus Prisse (c. 1850 BCE), with Gunn's 1906 English.

texts.title: The Instruction of Ptahhotep (Papyrus Prisse, complete)
texts.date_approx: composition attributed to the 5th Dynasty (c. 2400 BCE); manuscript c. 1850 BCE (12th Dynasty)
texts.source: Papyrus Prisse, BnF Egyptien 186-194 (photographs by Zunkir, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0) + TLA transliteration and hieroglyphs (ed. P. Dils, CC BY-SA 4.0) + English of Battiscombe Gunn (1906, public domain)
texts.description: The complete Instruction of Ptahhotep, the best known Egyptian wisdom text, on the 16 columns of the Papyrus Prisse (c. 1850 BCE), section by section with Gunn's 1906 English.

authors.name: Ptahhotep (attributed)
authors.bio: Vizier of King Isesi of the 5th Dynasty, named as the author of the Instruction of Ptahhotep; the text itself survives in Middle Kingdom copies.
